# LobsterAI **The open-source desktop AI agent that does real work on your computer.** Describe a task in plain language. LobsterAI reads your files, runs tools, drives a browser,
edits Office documents, and hands back finished work — at your desk or from your phone.

**English** · [简体中文](README_zh.md)

Download  ·  Quick start  ·  Features  ·  How it works  ·  Build & package  ·  Community

## Why LobsterAI Most AI assistants stop at an answer. LobsterAI is built to finish the job. - **It works where your work lives.** Point it at a folder and it reads spreadsheets, writes documents, runs scripts, and browses the web under configurable permission presets and interactive approvals. - **You see the result, not just a reply.** Web pages, charts, images, videos, PDFs, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files open in a side panel, ready to edit live alongside the agent or share as a link. - **It keeps working when you step away.** Schedule recurring jobs with the built-in SQLite scheduler, or message your desktop agent from WeChat, WeCom, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, and Discord. - **Open, extensible, and yours.** MIT-licensed, powered by a bundled [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) runtime with local storage and disabled upstream telemetry. Sign in to use built-in models, bring your own API keys, or extend it with Kits, Skills, MCP servers, and DSH plugins. Built by [NetEase Youdao](https://www.youdao.com/), LobsterAI is the first open-source desktop-grade agent from a major Chinese tech company. ## Features

Native Office live editing
Open Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) right in the app. Edit by hand, or let the agent modify documents live alongside you.

Kits, skills, connectors & DSH plugins
Install role-based kits for engineering, design, finance, sales, and more; pick individual skills, connect OAuth MCP servers, or install DeepSeek Harness ecosystem plugins.

Scheduled tasks & remote IM control

Turn any prompt into a recurring job — morning briefs, end-of-day wrap-ups, weekly reports, and project health checks — with run history and automatic delivery to chat apps.

Connect WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, or Discord once, then assign tasks to your desktop agent from your phone.

LobsterAI

The open-source desktop AI agent that does real work on your computer.

Describe a task in plain language. LobsterAI reads your files, runs tools, drives a browser,
edits Office documents, and hands back finished work — at your desk or from your phone.

English · 简体中文

Download  ·  Quick start  ·  Features  ·  How it works  ·  Build & package  ·  Community

Why LobsterAI

Most AI assistants stop at an answer. LobsterAI is built to finish the job.

  • It works where your work lives. Point it at a folder and it reads spreadsheets, writes documents, runs scripts, and browses the web under configurable permission presets and interactive approvals.
  • You see the result, not just a reply. Web pages, charts, images, videos, PDFs, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files open in a side panel, ready to edit live alongside the agent or share as a link.
  • It keeps working when you step away. Schedule recurring jobs with the built-in SQLite scheduler, or message your desktop agent from WeChat, WeCom, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, and Discord.
  • Open, extensible, and yours. MIT-licensed, powered by a bundled DeepSeek Harness (DSH) runtime with local storage and disabled upstream telemetry. Sign in to use built-in models, bring your own API keys, or extend it with Kits, Skills, MCP servers, and DSH plugins.

Built by NetEase Youdao, LobsterAI is the first open-source desktop-grade agent from a major Chinese tech company.

Features

Native Office live editing
Open Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) right in the app. Edit by hand, or let the agent modify documents live alongside you.

Kits, skills, connectors & DSH plugins
Install role-based kits for engineering, design, finance, sales, and more; pick individual skills, connect OAuth MCP servers, or install DeepSeek Harness ecosystem plugins.

Scheduled tasks & remote IM control

Turn any prompt into a recurring job — morning briefs, end-of-day wrap-ups, weekly reports, and project health checks — with run history and automatic delivery to chat apps.

Connect WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, or Discord once, then assign tasks to your desktop agent from your phone.

Everything in the box

Capability What you get
Cowork sessions Long-running tasks on local projects with streaming progress, tool timelines, session forks, automatic context compaction, and configurable permission presets (read-only, workspace-write, full access) with interactive approvals.
Office & creative workflows Native in-app editing for .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx via live agent bridges, plus guided PPT creation, image generation and in-place editing, and Remotion video workflows.
Artifacts and sharing Live side-panel previews for HTML, SVG, Mermaid, images, video, Markdown, code, PDF, Office files, and local web services, with one-click link sharing.
Built-in browser & search An in-app browser the agent can drive, with tabs, saved logins, passkey (WebAuthn) support, visual annotations, and built-in web search.
Computer use Desktop GUI automation so the agent can operate native apps on Windows x64 and macOS 13 or later.
Multi-agent & delegation Create agents with independent personas, models, skills, and working directories; add ready-made experts from the Expert Plaza; spawn subagents or delegate across agents with visible subagent sessions in the sidebar; bind agents to IM channels.
Skills & Kits Role-based kits plus built-in skills for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, web search, Remotion video, frontend design, stock research, content writing, IMAP/SMTP email, Youdao Note, and more. See SKILLs/.
DSH plugins & ecosystem Install, toggle, or remove DeepSeek Harness plugins from Settings → Plugins (using bundled pnpm), open the DSH Ecosystem View, use official bundles (AgentTeam, Worktree, LiveShare, DeepSeek Chat Import), and access the built-in dsh CLI shim.
MCP connectors Add local (stdio) or remote (Streamable HTTP / SSE) MCP servers from the marketplace, sign in with OAuth, and filter which tools each server exposes.
IM channels WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, and Discord via LobsterAI's bundled DSH channels driver. Multi-instance platforms can route each bot to a different agent.
Scheduled tasks Built-in SQLite scheduler (LobsterScheduler) with templates, run logs, per-task working directories, and automatic IM result delivery.
Desktop companion & voice A floating orb for quick prompts, screenshots, and actions on selected text (translate, read aloud, and more), plus built-in voice input (ASR).
Memory Local Markdown workspace files (AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, SOUL.md, USER.md, daily notes) carry preferences across sessions. Legacy Dreaming diaries remain readable in memory settings.
Models Built-in models (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax, and more) after sign-in, or bring your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, Doubao, Qianfan, StepFun, MiMo, Ollama, LM Studio, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Library Unified workspace view of every local artifact and shared file your agents generate across sessions.

Things to try

Scenario Example prompt
Build a local tool "I still track inventory and sales in Excel. Build a local inventory system that records purchases and sales, calculates stock and profit, and opens in my browser."
Analyze local data "Use product-growth.xlsx to build a visual dashboard and summarize the main growth drivers."
Make a deck "Research the AI agent market and turn the findings into a presentation."
Check a web dashboard "Open the ads dashboard every morning, check spend and conversion anomalies, and summarize likely causes."
Screen documents "Turn the resumes in this folder into a screening sheet and shortlist the strongest candidates against the JD."
Run scheduled work "Every weekday at 9 AM, collect yesterday's AI news and send me a concise digest."

Quick start

  1. Install LobsterAI. Download it from the official website, or get the latest release directly: macOS (Apple Silicon) · macOS (Intel) · Windows x64
  2. Choose a model. Sign in to use the built-in models, or add your own API key under Settings → Custom Model.
  3. Give it a task. Pick a working folder, choose a permission preset, describe what you want, and approve actions as it works. Generated files open in the side panel.
  4. Go further. Install kits from Kits · Skills · Connectors, manage DSH plugins in Settings → Plugins, set up recurring work in Scheduled Tasks, or connect a chat app under Settings → IM Bot.

Note

Upgrading from legacy OpenClaw versions: On first launch after upgrading, LobsterAI runs an offline atomic migrator before DSH starts. It snapshots lobsterai.sqlite, migrates your agent workspaces, memories, sessions, scheduled tasks, permissions, and MCP OAuth tokens, safely archives retired or incompatible modules under userData/legacy-openclaw-backup/, rolls back automatically on failure, and displays a migration summary.

How it works

flowchart LR
  subgraph App["LobsterAI desktop app (Electron)"]
    UI["Renderer<br/>React · Redux · Tailwind<br/>sessions · artifacts · Office editors"]
    Main["Main process<br/>Cowork · SQLite · LobsterScheduler<br/>MCP/OAuth · Built-in browser"]
    subgraph DshHost["Bundled DeepSeek Harness"]
      DSH["DSH Agent runtime"]
      HostBundle["@lobsterai/dsh-bundle<br/>host tools · guards · bridges"]
      Channels["@lobsterai/dsh-channels<br/>IM channel drivers"]
    end
    UI <-->|"preload IPC"| Main
    Main <-->|"session control · config · events"| DSH
    DSH <--> HostBundle
    Main <-->|"inbound · replies"| Channels
  end
  DSH --> Models["LLM providers"]
  HostBundle --> Tools["Files · shell · MCP · browser<br/>Office · computer use · DSH plugins"]
  Chat["Chat apps<br/>WeChat · WeCom · Feishu · DingTalk …"] <--> Channels
Loading
  • Cowork is LobsterAI's desktop product layer. It owns sessions, messages, permission presets, artifacts, Office editor bridges, SQLite scheduling (LobsterScheduler), MCP OAuth, and IM bindings.
  • DeepSeek Harness (DSH) runs the agent as an offline-complete bundled runtime (@deepseek-ai/dsh, pinned in package.json). LobsterAI layers two first-party Cordis bundles under dsh-bundles/:
    • lobsterai-host (@lobsterai/dsh-bundle): model/web-search/MCP bridges, persona and workspace scoping, progressive tool disclosure, approval guards, multi-agent delegation, ops RPC, and privacy/telemetry disabling.
    • lobsterai-channels (@lobsterai/dsh-channels): native drivers for WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, and Discord.
  • The renderer is sandboxed with context isolation and talks to the main process only through the preload IPC bridge.

Build and package

Prerequisites

  • Node.js >=24.15.0 <25
  • npm >=11.17.0 <12
  • Git and tar
  • better-sqlite3@13.0.3 ships prebuilt N-API binaries, so Windows builds do not require Visual Studio C++ Build Tools.

Run from source

git clone https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI.git
cd LobsterAI
npm install

# First run: build the pinned DSH runtime for the current platform and start Electron
npm run electron:dev:dsh

# Daily development once vendor/dsh-runtime/current is prepared
npm run electron:dev

Useful runtime options and checks:

  • DSH_NPM_REGISTRY=<url> overrides the npm registry when fetching @deepseek-ai/dsh; DSH_FORCE_BUILD=1 forces a runtime rebuild.
  • Verify the runtime and privacy guard after runtime or patch changes: npm run dsh:runtime:verify · npm run dsh:upgrade-check · npm run dsh:e2e.

Package installers

Build on a host matching the target operating system and architecture so native dependencies match. Outputs are written to release/.

# Clean install and clear stale main-process build output
npm ci
npx rimraf dist dist-electron

# Build the installer for your target
npm run dist:mac:arm64   # macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg)
npm run dist:mac:x64     # macOS Intel (.dmg)
npm run dist:win         # Windows x64 full offline NSIS installer (.exe)

Windows distribution variants (channel builds and CDN web installers):

# Full offline installer tagged for a distribution channel
npm run dist:win:channel -- --keyfrom <channel> [--silent]

# Lightweight web installer stub that downloads the .nsis.7z app payload from your CDN
npm run dist:win:web -- --keyfrom <channel> [--silent] [--pkg-base-url <cdn-dir> | --pkg-url <package-url>]

How the packaging pipeline works

  • Self-contained DSH runtime: scripts/build-dsh-runtime.cjs fetches the pinned @deepseek-ai/dsh npm package (no sibling source checkout required), installs platform/arch production dependencies plus a pinned pnpm (package-manager/pnpm) for end-user plugin installs, applies version-scoped patches from scripts/dsh-patches/<dsh.version>/, prunes redundant heavy native packages (libreoffice-kit-*, sherpa-onnx-*) that LobsterAI replaces natively, and caches the result under vendor/dsh-runtime/<target> (reused automatically when target, versions, and patch hashes match).
  • macOS (.dmg): Ships dsh-runtime/, dsh-bundles/, SKILLs/, and optional computer-use/ under Contents/Resources/. afterPack strips node_modules/.bin symlinks inside packaged DSH trees for codesign compatibility, and dist:mac:arm64 runs dsh:upgrade-check before packaging.
  • Windows (NSIS .exe & nsis-web): Runs predist:win (dsh:runtime:win-x64), enforces the verify:installer-patches gate (patches/app-builder-lib+*.patch), builds selection-hook, prepares the embedded Windows Python 3.11 runtime (setup:python-runtime), and packs dsh-runtime/, dsh-bundles/, SKILLs/, and python-win/ into a single win-resources.tar unpacked by unpack-dsh-resources.cjs during installation for faster installs. Run npm run setup:mingit if you also want bundled PortableGit for Git-sourced DSH plugin installs without system Git.
  • Standalone runtime archives: Maintain CDN-hosted runtime tarballs in package.json (dsh.runtimes) with npm run dsh:runtime:pack, npm run dsh:runtime:url, and npm run dsh:runtime:verify-urls.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for offline/private-mirror environment variables, upgrading DSH versions, tests, linting, and the full project map.

Security and privacy

  • Local-first, isolated storage: Desktop sessions, messages, scheduled tasks, and settings live locally in lobsterai.sqlite. Under the same user data directory, dsh-profile/ holds LobsterAI's isolated DSH state and workspaces/<agentId>/ holds agent instructions and memory — completely separate from any standalone DSH installation.
  • Upstream telemetry disabled: dsh-bundles/lobsterai-host/cordis.patch.yml explicitly disables upstream DSH telemetry and DeepSeek account plugins, verified automatically by npm run dsh:upgrade-check.
  • Permission controls & sandboxing: Tool actions follow each session's permission preset (read-only, workspace-write, or full access) and interactive approval prompts. Renderer windows run with context isolation, sandboxing, and no Node.js integration.

Community

Join the WeChat group for help, feedback, and release news. You can also follow @LobsterAIYoudao on X.

Report bugs and request features through GitHub Issues.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Read CONTRIBUTING.md to set up your environment, and look for good first issues to get started.

Star history

License

## What's Changed

This release moves the agent engine from OpenClaw to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — 106 PRs, the largest architectural migration in LobsterAI's history. Sessions, experts, memory, IM channels, media generation, office editing and plugins were all rebuilt on the new engine, closing every capability gap left by the old one.

## ✨ Highlights

- **New engine, same app** — DSH is now the default runtime, with native desktop integration across sessions, tooling and packaging ([#3239](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/3239))
- **Agents that work together** — cross-agent collaboration and specialist delegation let the main agent hand off subtasks to dedicated specialists ([#3137](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/3137))
- **Every IM channel back online** — POPO added; WeCom, Weixin, Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram and Discord all restored with group-chat routing ([#3160](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/3160), [#3232](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/3232))

releases.body:
## Highlights

- 🎨 **Guided PPT cover creation** — a new step-by-step cover wizard, plus configurable homepage examples to get you started faster (#3072, #3129).
- ⏪ **Session navigation & prompt history** — move back and forward between sessions and recall previous prompts with ease (#3107).
- 🔍 **Window zoom** — zoom the main window in and out, with a clear on-screen indicator (#3106).

## 🚀 New Features

- **PPT:** Configurable homepage examples and a guided cover-creation flow (#3072) @btc69m979y-dotcom
- **PPT:** Smoother home quick actions and wizard navigation (#3129) @fisherdaddy
- **Sessions:** Back/forward navigation and prompt history recall (#3107) @fisherdaddy
- **Window:** Main-window zoom with a zoom-level indicator (#3106) @fisherdaddy
- **Models:** Server-configured custom tags in the model selector, with localization support (#3110, #3115) @Mind-Hand
- **Account menu:** Server-configured "More" links (#3111) @Mind-Hand
- **Experts:** Opt-in updates for installed presets — stay in control of when presets change (#3118) @btc69m979y-dotcom

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Browser & Sessions
- Scoped Chrome UA and CDP attach to avoid Cloudflare verification

releases.name: LobsterAI 2026.11.16
releases.body:
# What's Changed

This release brings message editing with version history, inline read-aloud, full-text task search, and selectable context windows up to 1M tokens — plus a faster startup and a smoother desktop companion experience.

## ✨ Highlights

- **Edit your messages, switch between versions.** Rework any prompt and browse alternate versions of a turn, including turns the gateway never recorded. (#3051, #3086)
- **Read replies aloud.** Completed replies now have an inline read-aloud control. (#3045)
- **Search across your tasks.** Find conversations by content with the new task search. (#3073)
- **Context windows up to 1M tokens.** Explicitly choose the context window for supported models. (#3059)
- **Expert Plaza is live.** Discover and summon experts from the new entry points. (#3032)
- **Faster startup.** Large tool catalogs are deferred behind Tool Search, and gateway startup was trimmed. (#3029, #3066)

## 🚀 Features

- feat(cowork): support editing user messages with version switching by @fisherdaddy in https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/3051
- feat(cowork): add inline read aloud for completed replies by @btc69m979y-dotcom in https://gith

releases.name: LobsterAI 2026.11.6
releases.body:
## 2026.11.2

A release focused on reliability: chat streams now survive mid-reply drops, oversized contexts recover with visible compaction progress, the image pipeline is cheaper and less chatty, and installers ship a lot less dead weight.

## Highlights

1. Model streams reconnect automatically when they drop mid-reply instead of leaving the message truncated (#2974).
2. Oversized conversations now recover instead of failing, with compaction progress surfaced in the UI (#2982, #3014, #2988).
3. One image confirmation can now approve the rest of a turn's images, and delivery recovery is more robust (#2995, #2980, #2994).
4. Installer and runtime bundles are significantly slimmer: no source maps, no tsc output, no debug-only files (#2976, #2985, #2996).
5. DeepSeek Harness runtime moved to 0.2.2-rc.1 with cleaner shutdown and leftover reclamation (#2989, #3007, #3008).

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source desktop agent capable of executing real OS workflows and responding to mobile messaging commands.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: LobsterAI is a highly capable, desktop-grade AI agent robustly built on the OpenClaw framework that interacts directly with a user's operating system to perform complex tasks. It flawlessly executes real, intensive desktop operations—such as analyzing data, compiling web research, and generating detailed slide decks—by directly controlling native applications. Uniquely, it seamlessly bridges the traditional desktop environment with mobile interfaces by readily accepting remote commands. It heavily supports popular messaging platforms like WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram to execute background tasks incredibly seamlessly from anywhere.
keyFeatures: Native OS control: Interfaces completely directly with the desktop environment to smoothly operate native applications and complex workflows.
Cross-platform messaging: Receives complex task prompts and direct commands remotely via WeChat, Telegram, Feishu, and DingTalk.
Automated research capabilities: Conducts highly comprehensive web searches and intelligently compiles findings into highly structured documents.
Intelligent data processing: Highly capable of ingesting raw data files and independently outputting sophisticated analytical reports or slide presentations.
OpenClaw architecture: Built heavily on a specialized framework expressly designed for highly reliable, persistent OS-level agent execution.
Scheduled task management: Allows users to securely create highly recurring work either by conversation or through a dedicated UI.

useCases.title: Remote desktop automation
useCases.description: Texting a direct command from a mobile phone to instantly have the desktop machine autonomously research a complex topic and generate a report.

useCases.title: Automated document generation
useCases.description: Instructing the agent remotely to independently process a folder of raw data and autonomously build a highly professional presentation slide deck.

useCases.title: Multi-modal desktop workflows
useCases.description: Bridging vital communication flawlessly between mobile messaging apps and heavy desktop applications without ever requiring any human intervention.

useCases.title: Background task delegation
useCases.description: Assigning incredibly time-consuming web research tasks directly to the local machine while actively away from the keyboard.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Knowledge workers, dedicated researchers, and serious automation enthusiasts wanting to remotely control their desktop machines to execute complex operational tasks. It provides extreme flexibility for users who operate primarily on mobile.
